creator: FactTechz
title: Highest INSANE Temperatures Ever Achieved By Humans!

script.about: How human experiments like nuclear tests and CERN particle collisions created temperatures hotter than the Sun.

beats.said: Earth's most dangerous experiments almost destroyed our world.
beats.shows: Presenter speaking with skull emoji overhead

beats.said: These experiments could have wiped out humanity completely.
beats.shows: Presenter in front of burning globe

beats.said: They unleashed cataclysmic explosive forces.
beats.shows: Presenter in front of bright explosion cloud

beats.said: Consider the core temperature of our Sun.
beats.shows: Glowing Sun sphere graphic

beats.said: Sun's core reaches 15 million degrees Celsius.
beats.shows: Presenter points to Sun core diagram with counter reaching 15M C

beats.said: During the first atomic bomb test conducted by USA.
beats.shows: City nuclear detonation animation

beats.said: Back in the year 1945.
beats.shows: Presenter pointing to pink 1945 graphic

beats.said: The historic Trinity nuclear explosion test detonated.
beats.shows: Archival footage of the Trinity fireball expanding

beats.said: The surrounding desert soil became intensely scorched.
beats.shows: Cracked parched desert earth

beats.said: Temperatures soared to 15 million degrees Celsius.
beats.shows: Nuclear mushroom cloud with counter hitting 1.5 crore C

beats.said: Exactly matching the heat of the Sun's core.
beats.shows: Presenter in front of fire with BARABAR text banner

beats.said: Then rival superpower Russia decided to respond.
beats.shows: Presenter against waving Russian flag

beats.said: Determined to demonstrate far greater destructive power.
beats.shows: Humorous dialogue text card on black screen

beats.said: In 1961 the Soviet Union tested Tsar Bomba.
beats.shows: Waving Russian flag with green 1961 text

beats.said: The colossal nuclear detonation erupted.
beats.shows: Mushroom cloud engulfing city skyline

beats.said: The temperature generated was unfathomable.
beats.shows: Presenter explaining with hand gestures

beats.said: Reaching 100 million degrees, seven times hotter than Sun.
beats.shows: Counter rolling to 10 crore C followed by 7X text pop

beats.said: Switzerland scientists decided to push boundaries even further.
beats.shows: Presenter in front of waving Swiss flag

beats.said: At the CERN particle physics laboratory.
beats.shows: Large Hadron Collider facility with skull icon and label

beats.said: In the milestone year of 2012.
beats.shows: Presenter against wireframe with 2012 text pop

beats.said: Two subatomic particles accelerated near light speed.
beats.shows: Presenter before atom particle tracks graphic

beats.said: They collided together in a blinding flash.
beats.shows: Blinding collision energy burst behind presenter

beats.said: Generating a staggering 5 trillion degrees Celsius.
beats.shows: Presenter with bold 5 Lakh Crore C text graphic

beats.said: Equivalent to 360,000 Suns combined.
beats.shows: Solar eruption graphic with 3,60,000 Suns title

beats.said: A temperature unimaginable in cosmic terms.
beats.shows: Split screen of plasma beam and field of suns

beats.said: Please like and subscribe for more amazing facts.
beats.shows: Presenter asking viewers to like and subscribe with graphic buttons
